        console.log('✅ Detection filters configured:', window.detectionFilters);
        
        // Track detection state
        let detectionHistory = [];
        let isTargetVisible = false;
        
        // Listen for MindAR's targetFound event
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
            console.log('🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR');
            
            // Add to history with timestamp
            detectionHistory.push({
                time: Date.now(),
                confidence: event.detail?.confidence || 0.9,
                anchor: event.detail?.anchor
            });
            
            // Keep only recent detections (last 200ms)
            detectionHistory = detectionHistory.filter(d => Date.now() - d.time < 200);
            
            // Apply confidence threshold
            const avgConfidence = detectionHistory.length > 0 
                ? detectionHistory.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.confidence, 0) / detectionHistory.length
                : 0.9;
            
            console.log(`📊 Detection confidence: ${(avgConfidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% (threshold: ${(window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
            
            // If below threshold, suppress the detection
            if (avgConfidence < window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold) {
                console.log('🚫 Detection rejected - below confidence threshold');
                return;
            }
            
            // Increment warmup counter
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount++;
            if (window.detectionFilters.frameCount < window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames) {
                console.log(`⏳ Warmup: frame ${window.detectionFilters.frameCount}/${window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames}`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Detection passed all filters!
            if (!isTargetVisible) {
                isTargetVisible = true;
                console.log('✅ Target found and passed all filters! Dispatching custom event...');
                
                // Dispatch our own event that handlers can listen to
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersPassed', {
                    detail: {
                        anchor: event.detail?.anchor,
                        confidence: avgConfidence
                    }
                });
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });
        
        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
            console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
            
            // Only report lost after missFrames
            if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                isTargetVisible = false;
                window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                
                // Dispatch our own event
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });

    window.fetch = function(...args) {
        const url = args[0];
        if (url && url.includes('.mind')) {
            console.log(`📥 Fetching .mind file: ${url}`);
            return originalFetch.apply(this, args).then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    console.error(`❌ Failed to load .mind file: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
                }
                return response;
            }).catch(err => {
                console.error(`❌ Network error loading .mind file:`, err);
                throw err;
            });
        }
        return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    };

            };
            
            // Listen for component initialization

    // Listen for targetLost event
    target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
        if (targetWasDetected) {
            console.log('❌ Target lost - showing video again');
            
            // Show background video again so user can scan
            const backgroundVideos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
            backgroundVideos.forEach(video => {
                video.style.visibility = 'visible';
                video.style.opacity = '1';
                video.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; // Re-enable interaction
            });
            
            // Show A4 frame guide again
            const a4Frame = document.getElementById('a4-frame');
            if (a4Frame) {
                a4Frame.classList.remove('hidden');
                console.log('📦 A4 frame shown');
            }
            
            videoHiddenForTarget = false;
            
            // Don't reset immediately, wait for potential re-detection
            targetLostResetTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                console.log('✅ Target reset - ready for next detection');
                targetWasDetected = false;
            }, 1000);
        }
    });
```

    // Use async IIFE to wait for API response before setting MindAR attributes
    (async () => {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/settings/ar-tracking`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data && (data.filterMinCF !== undefined || data.filterBeta !== undefined)) {
                // Use API values if they exist - the API always returns what's in ar-settings.json
                // (which was explicitly set by the admin)
                const apiMinCF = parseFloat(data.filterMinCF);
                const apiBeta = parseFloat(data.filterBeta);
                const apiWarmup = parseInt(data.warmupTolerance || '5');
                const apiMiss = parseInt(data.missTolerance || '5');
                
                // Always use API values since they represent what admin saved
                console.log('✅ Using settings from API (admin panel values):', data);
                filterMinCF = apiMinCF;
                filterBeta = apiBeta;
                warmupTolerance = apiWarmup;
                missTolerance = apiMiss;
                
                // Store in localStorage for this domain too
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterMinCF', filterMinCF.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterBeta', filterBeta.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_warmupTolerance', warmupTolerance.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_missTolerance', missTolerance.toString());
                
                console.log('💾 Synced API settings to localStorage');
            }

            console.warn('⚠️ Could not fetch settings from API:', err);
            console.log('ℹ️ Using localStorage values or defaults');

    // Use async IIFE to wait for API response before setting MindAR attributes
    (async () => {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/settings/ar-tracking`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data && (data.filterMinCF !== undefined || data.filterBeta !== undefined)) {
                // Only use API values if they differ from defaults (meaning they were actually set)
                const apiMinCF = parseFloat(data.filterMinCF);
                const apiBeta = parseFloat(data.filterBeta);
                
                // If API has non-default values, use them
                if ((apiMinCF !== 0.003 || apiBeta !== 0.025)) {
                    console.log('✅ Using settings from API (admin panel values):', data);
                    filterMinCF = apiMinCF;
                    filterBeta = apiBeta;
                    warmupTolerance = parseInt(data.warmupTolerance || '5');
                    missTolerance = parseInt(data.missTolerance || '5');
                    
                    // Store in localStorage for this domain too
                    localStorage.setItem('ar_filterMinCF', filterMinCF.toString());
                    localStorage.setItem('ar_filterBeta', filterBeta.toString());
                    localStorage.setItem('ar_warmupTolerance', warmupTolerance.toString());
                    localStorage.setItem('ar_missTolerance', missTolerance.toString());
                    
                    console.log('💾 Synced API settings to localStorage');
                } else {
                    console.log('ℹ️ API has default values, using localStorage');
                }
            }
        } catch (err) {

        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        let targetLostTimeout = null;
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            // Only process if we have a targetLost timeout pending
            // This debounces rapid lost/found events
            if (!targetLostTimeout) {
                window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
                console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
                
                // Start timeout - if no targetFound within 300ms, then it's really lost
                targetLostTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                        console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                        isTargetVisible = false;
                        window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                        window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                        
                        // Dispatch our own event
                        const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                        scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
                    }
                    targetLostTimeout = null;
                }, 300); // Wait 300ms to see if targetFound comes back
            }
        });
```

        logAdminActivity('UPLOAD_FAILED', '.mind file validation failed: ' . $mindValidation['message']);
        jsonResponse(['message' => '.mind bestand: ' . $mindValidation['message']], 400);
    }

        if ($fallbackValidation['valid']) {
            $hasFallback = true;
        } else {
            logAdminActivity('UPLOAD_WARNING', 'Fallback .mind file validation failed: ' . $fallbackValidation['message']);
        }
    }

// Set MindAR scene with correct parameters
function setMindARScene(scene, filterMinCF, filterBeta, warmupTolerance, missTolerance) {
    console.log('📊 PARSED MindAR tracking settings:');
    
    // Set the AR marker dynamically based on first poster with ar_marker
    if (window.allPosters && window.allPosters.length > 0) {
        // Find first poster with a valid ar_marker
        const posterWithMarker = window.allPosters.find(p => p.ar_marker);
        if (posterWithMarker) {
            // Convert ar_marker path to full .mind file path
            const markerPath = posterWithMarker.ar_marker.endsWith('.mind') 
                ? posterWithMarker.ar_marker 
                : posterWithMarker.ar_marker + '.mind';
            
            // Get fallback marker path if it exists
            let fallbackPath = null;
            if (posterWithMarker.ar_marker_fallback) {
                fallbackPath = posterWithMarker.ar_marker_fallback.endsWith('.mind')
                    ? posterWithMarker.ar_marker_fallback
                    : posterWithMarker.ar_marker_fallback + '.mind';
            }
            
            // Store both paths for potential fallback switching
            window.currentMarkerPath = markerPath;
            window.currentFallbackPath = fallbackPath;
            window.trackingFailureCount = 0;
            window.trackingFailureThreshold = 5; // Try fallback after 5 consecutive failures
            
            console.log('🎯 Setting MindAR marker from poster:', markerPath);
            if (fallbackPath) {
                console.log('🔄 Fallback marker available:', fallbackPath);
            }
            
            // === FIX FOR IPHONE DEVICE PARAMETERS ===
            // When MindAR fails to load DPDB device match, provide manual camera intrinsics
            // For iPhone with standard wide camera at 1x zoom
            // These are approximate but help MindAR track better when device params are missing

        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        let targetLostTimeout = null;
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            // Increment tracking failure count
            if (window.trackingFailureCount !== undefined) {
                window.trackingFailureCount++;
                console.log(`📊 Tracking failure count: ${window.trackingFailureCount}/${window.trackingFailureThreshold}`);
                
                // Check if we should try fallback marker
                if (window.trackingFailureCount >= window.trackingFailureThreshold && 
                    window.currentFallbackPath && 
                    !window.fallbackAttempted) {
                    console.log('🔄 Switching to fallback marker due to persistent tracking loss');
                    window.fallbackAttempted = true;
                    
                    // Update to fallback marker
                    scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', 
                        `imageTargetSrc: ${window.currentFallbackPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1;`);
                    
                    // Reset failure count for fallback
                    window.trackingFailureCount = 0;
                    
                    console.log('✅ Fallback marker loaded, attempting to track again');
                }
            }
            
            // Only process if we have a targetLost timeout pending
            // This debounces rapid lost/found events
            if (!targetLostTimeout) {
                window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
                console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
                
                // Start timeout - if no targetFound within 500ms, then it's really lost
                targetLostTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                        console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                        isTargetVisible = false;
                        window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                        window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                        
                        // Dispatch our own event
                        const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                        scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
                    }
                    targetLostTimeout = null;
                }, 500); // Wait 500ms to see if targetFound comes back (doubled from 300ms)
            }
        });
```

        // Find first poster with a valid ar_marker
        const posterWithMarker = window.allPosters.find(p => p.ar_marker_hq);
        if (posterWithMarker) {
            // Convert ar_marker_hq path to full .mind file path
            const hqPath = posterWithMarker.ar_marker_hq.endsWith('.mind') 
                ? posterWithMarker.ar_marker_hq 
                : posterWithMarker.ar_marker_hq + '.mind';
            
            // Get LQ marker path if it exists
            let lqPath = null;
            if (posterWithMarker.ar_marker_lq) {
                lqPath = posterWithMarker.ar_marker_lq.endsWith('.mind')
                    ? posterWithMarker.ar_marker_lq
                    : posterWithMarker.ar_marker_lq + '.mind';
            }
            
            // Store both paths for quality switching
            window.hqMarkerPath = hqPath;
            window.lqMarkerPath = lqPath;
            window.currentMarkerPath = hqPath; // Start with HQ
            window.isUsingLQ = false;
            window.confidenceHistory = [];
            window.lowConfidenceCount = 0;
            window.lowConfidenceThreshold = 3; // Switch to LQ after 3 low-confidence detections

        // Listen for MindAR's targetFound event
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
            console.log('🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR');
            
            // Add to history with timestamp
            detectionHistory.push({
                time: Date.now(),
                confidence: event.detail?.confidence || 0.9,
                anchor: event.detail?.anchor
            });
            
            // Keep only recent detections (last 200ms)
            detectionHistory = detectionHistory.filter(d => Date.now() - d.time < 200);
            
            // Apply confidence threshold
            const avgConfidence = detectionHistory.length > 0 
                ? detectionHistory.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.confidence, 0) / detectionHistory.length
                : 0.9;
            
            console.log(`📊 Detection confidence: ${(avgConfidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% (threshold: ${(window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
            
            // ===== QUALITY SWITCHING LOGIC =====
            // If confidence is low and we have LQ marker, consider switching
            if (window.lqMarkerPath && avgConfidence < 0.5) {
                window.lowConfidenceCount++;
                console.log(`⚠️ Low confidence detected (${window.lowConfidenceCount}/${window.lowConfidenceThreshold})`);
                
                // Switch to LQ marker after N low-confidence detections
                if (window.lowConfidenceCount >= window.lowConfidenceThreshold && !window.isUsingLQ) {
                    console.log('🔄 Switching to Low Quality marker (better for distance)');
                    scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', 
                        `imageTargetSrc: ${window.lqMarkerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1;`);
                    window.isUsingLQ = true;
                    window.lowConfidenceCount = 0;
                }
            } else if (avgConfidence >= 0.7 && window.isUsingLQ) {
                // Switch back to HQ if quality improves
                console.log('✅ Good confidence, switching back to HQ marker');
                scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', 
                    `imageTargetSrc: ${window.hqMarkerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no; maxTrack: 1;`);
                window.isUsingLQ = false;
                window.lowConfidenceCount = 0;
            } else if (avgConfidence >= 0.5) {
                // Reset low confidence counter when tracking improves
                window.lowConfidenceCount = 0;
            }
            
            // If below threshold, suppress the detection
            if (avgConfidence < window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold) {
                console.log('🚫 Detection rejected - below confidence threshold');
                return;
            }
            
            // Increment warmup counter
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount++;
            if (window.detectionFilters.frameCount < window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames) {
                console.log(`⏳ Warmup: frame ${window.detectionFilters.frameCount}/${window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames}`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Cancel any pending lost timeout since we found it again
            if (targetLostTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostTimeout);
                targetLostTimeout = null;
                console.log('🔄 Cancelled pending targetLost - re-detected!');
            }
            
            // Reset miss count since we found it
            window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
            
            // Detection passed all filters!
            if (!isTargetVisible) {
                isTargetVisible = true;
                console.log('✅ Target found and passed all filters! Dispatching custom event...');
                
                // Dispatch our own event that handlers can listen to
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersPassed', {
                    detail: {
                        anchor: event.detail?.anchor,
                        confidence: avgConfidence
                    }
                });
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });
```

        // Listen for MindAR's targetFound event
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
            console.log('🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR');
            
            // Add to history with timestamp
            detectionHistory.push({
                time: Date.now(),
                confidence: event.detail?.confidence || 0.9,
                anchor: event.detail?.anchor
            });
            
            // Keep only recent detections (last 200ms)
            detectionHistory = detectionHistory.filter(d => Date.now() - d.time < 200);
            
            // Apply confidence threshold
            const avgConfidence = detectionHistory.length > 0 
                ? detectionHistory.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.confidence, 0) / detectionHistory.length
                : 0.9;
            
            console.log(`📊 Detection confidence: ${(avgConfidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% (threshold: ${(window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
            
            // If below threshold, suppress the detection
            if (avgConfidence < window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold) {
                console.log('🚫 Detection rejected - below confidence threshold');
                return;
            }
            
            // Increment warmup counter
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount++;
            if (window.detectionFilters.frameCount < window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames) {
                console.log(`⏳ Warmup: frame ${window.detectionFilters.frameCount}/${window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames}`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Cancel any pending lost timeout since we found it again
            if (targetLostTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostTimeout);
                targetLostTimeout = null;
                console.log('🔄 Cancelled pending targetLost - re-detected!');
            }
            
            // Reset miss count since we found it
            window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
            
            // Reset tracking failure count since we successfully found it
            if (window.trackingFailureCount !== undefined) {
                window.trackingFailureCount = 0;
                console.log('✅ Tracking successful - reset failure counter');
            }
            
            // Detection passed all filters!
            if (!isTargetVisible) {
                isTargetVisible = true;
                console.log('✅ Target found and passed all filters! Dispatching custom event...');
                
                // Dispatch our own event that handlers can listen to
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersPassed', {
                    detail: {
                        anchor: event.detail?.anchor,
                        confidence: avgConfidence
                    }
                });
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });

        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        let targetLostTimeout = null;
        let lastTargetFoundTime = 0;
        
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            // Check if this lost came too quickly after a found
            // If so, ignore it (it's just noise/flickering)
            const timeSinceLast = Date.now() - lastTargetFoundTime;
            if (timeSinceLast < 200) {
                console.log(`⚡ Ignoring quick targetLost (${timeSinceLast}ms after found) - likely flickering`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Only process if we have a targetLost timeout pending
            // This debounces rapid lost/found events
            if (!targetLostTimeout) {
                window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
                console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
                
                // Start timeout - if no targetFound within 1000ms, then it's really lost
                targetLostTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                        console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                        isTargetVisible = false;
                        window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                        window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                        
                        // Dispatch our own event
                        const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                        scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
                    }
                    targetLostTimeout = null;
                }, 1000); // Wait 1000ms (doubled from 500ms) to see if targetFound comes back
            }
        });

            if (event.detail?.anchor) {

                // Store position in history
                window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.push({
                    x: anchor.x || 0,
                    y: anchor.y || 0,
                    z: anchor.z || 0,
                    scale: anchor.scale || 1

                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > window.detectionFilters.maxHistorySize) {
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.shift();

                // Calculate smoothed position (weighted average - more weight to recent frames)
                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > 0) {
                    let smoothX = 0, smoothY = 0, smoothZ = 0, smoothScale = 0;
                    let totalWeight = 0;
                    
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.forEach((pos, i) => {
                        // More recent positions get higher weight
                        const weight = (i + 1) / window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length;
                        smoothX += pos.x * weight;
                        smoothY += pos.y * weight;
                        smoothZ += pos.z * weight;
                        smoothScale += pos.scale * weight;
                        totalWeight += weight;
                    });
                    
                    // Apply smoothed values back to anchor
                    anchor.x = smoothX / totalWeight;
                    anchor.y = smoothY / totalWeight;
                    anchor.z = smoothZ / totalWeight;
                    anchor.scale = smoothScale / totalWeight;
                }

_**User (2025-11-20 13:27:22Z)**_

Tracking Config
MindAR comes with the following configurable parameters to fine tune the tracking.

Smoothing Control
Jittering is a common issue in AR applications. The library computes the position of the targets in every frames. The problem is that there are always slight variations across aframes (e.g. noises coming from camera input or computational errors) even though you may think you are holding the devices steadily. Result is that the augmented contents will appear shaky.

One solution to smooth the jittering is to apply filtering. At a high level, it means taking some kind of rolling average of multiple frames to position the targets. The contents will then appeared more stable.

However, smoothing also comes with a price. Since we are using the previous N frames to interpolate the position, there will be a delay for the content to move to the latest position. This is more obvious if you move the camera quickly.

MindAR implements OneEuroFilter. There are two adjustable parameters called cutoff frequency (filterMinCF) and speed coefficient (filterBeta). In general, decreasing the value of filterMinCF can reduce the jittering and increasing the value of filterBeta reduce the delay. They are, however, somehow fighting against each others.

They default values of filterMinCF and filterBeta are 0.001 and 1000. You can change them by specifying these parameters in mindar-image attribute. e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="filterMinCF:0.1; filterBeta: 10"/>

WarmUp Tolerance
By default, there is a small intentional delay to trigger the target found event to avoid false positive. More specifically, it requires the target image being detected in a continuos of warmupTolerance frames to be considered a success. The default value of warmupTolerance is 5, and you can change it by specifying this parameter in the mindar-image attribute, e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="warmupTolerance: 1"/>

Miss Tolerance
Similar, there is also a small intentional delay to trigger the target lost event. It requires the target image being un-detected in a continuous of missTolerance frames. The default value of missTolerance is 5, and you can change it by specifying this parameter in the mindar-image attribute, e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="missTolerance: 1"/>

Tracking Config
MindAR comes with the following configurable parameters to fine tune the tracking.

Smoothing Control
Jittering is a common issue in AR applications. The library computes the position of the targets in every frames. The problem is that there are always slight variations across aframes (e.g. noises coming from camera input or computational errors) even though you may think you are holding the devices steadily. Result is that the augmented contents will appear shaky.

One solution to smooth the jittering is to apply filtering. At a high level, it means taking some kind of rolling average of multiple frames to position the targets. The contents will then appeared more stable.

However, smoothing also comes with a price. Since we are using the previous N frames to interpolate the position, there will be a delay for the content to move to the latest position. This is more obvious if you move the camera quickly.

MindAR implements OneEuroFilter. There are two adjustable parameters called cutoff frequency (filterMinCF) and speed coefficient (filterBeta). In general, decreasing the value of filterMinCF can reduce the jittering and increasing the value of filterBeta reduce the delay. They are, however, somehow fighting against each others.

They default values of filterMinCF and filterBeta are 0.001 and 1000. You can change them by specifying these parameters in mindar-image attribute. e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="filterMinCF:0.1; filterBeta: 10"/>

WarmUp Tolerance
By default, there is a small intentional delay to trigger the target found event to avoid false positive. More specifically, it requires the target image being detected in a continuos of warmupTolerance frames to be considered a success. The default value of warmupTolerance is 5, and you can change it by specifying this parameter in the mindar-image attribute, e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="warmupTolerance: 1"/>

Miss Tolerance
Similar, there is also a small intentional delay to trigger the target lost event. It requires the target image being un-detected in a continuous of missTolerance frames. The default value of missTolerance is 5, and you can change it by specifying this parameter in the mindar-image attribute, e.g.

<a-scene mindar-image="missTolerance: 1"/>

```
function initializeMindAR() {
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    if (!scene) return;
    
    console.log('📱 MOBILE AR DEBUG - Start initialization');
    console.log('🔍 Checking localStorage for AR settings...');
    console.log('   ar_filterMinCF:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF'));
    console.log('   ar_filterBeta:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta'));
    console.log('   ar_warmupTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance'));
    console.log('   ar_missTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance'));
    console.log('📍 Current domain:', window.location.hostname);
    console.log('📍 Admin domain: www.interventie.org');
    
    let filterMinCF = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF') || '0.003');
    let filterBeta = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta') || '0.025');
    let warmupTolerance = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance') || '5');
    let missTolerance = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance') || '5');
    
    // Try to fetch settings from API - this ensures cross-domain settings work
    // The API will return the latest settings saved from admin panel
    console.log('📥 Attempting to fetch latest AR settings from API...');
    
    // Use async IIFE to wait for API response before setting MindAR attributes
    (async () => {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/settings/ar-tracking`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data && (data.filterMinCF !== undefined || data.filterBeta !== undefined)) {
                // Use API values if they exist - the API always returns what's in ar-settings.json
                // (which was explicitly set by the admin)
                const apiMinCF = parseFloat(data.filterMinCF);
                const apiBeta = parseFloat(data.filterBeta);
                const apiWarmup = parseInt(data.warmupTolerance || '5');
                const apiMiss = parseInt(data.missTolerance || '5');
                
                // Always use API values since they represent what admin saved
                console.log('✅ Using settings from API (admin panel values):', data);
                filterMinCF = apiMinCF;
                filterBeta = apiBeta;
                warmupTolerance = apiWarmup;
                missTolerance = apiMiss;
                
                // Store in localStorage for this domain too
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterMinCF', filterMinCF.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterBeta', filterBeta.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_warmupTolerance', warmupTolerance.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_missTolerance', missTolerance.toString());
                console.log('💾 Synced API settings to localStorage');
            } else {
                console.log('⚠️ No settings from API, using localStorage/defaults');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('⚠️ Could not fetch API settings, using localStorage/defaults:', error.message);
        }
        
        // NOW set the MindAR parameters with the correct values (after API fetch completes)
        setMindARScene(scene, filterMinCF, filterBeta, warmupTolerance, missTolerance);
    })();
}
```

Ah! **You're moving the camera away from the poster** — that's why it loses tracking! That's not a software problem at all.

So the jitter/instability you're experiencing is because:
1. MindAR finds the marker ✓
2. You move the camera away ✓
3. It loses the marker (correctly!) ✓
4. You move back ✓
5. It finds it again ✓

This repeating cycle *looks* like jitter but it's actually **normal behavior** when you're testing with physical movement.

        console.log('✅ MindAR configured with defaults - no custom filtering');

        let detectionHistory = [];
        let isTargetVisible = false;        let detectionHistory = [];

        // Listen for MindAR's targetFound event
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) => {
            console.log('🎯 TargetFound event received from MindAR');
            
            // Add to history with timestamp
            detectionHistory.push({
                time: Date.now(),
                confidence: event.detail?.confidence || 0.9,
                anchor: event.detail?.anchor
            });
            
            // Record this found time for flickering detection
            lastTargetFoundTime = Date.now();
            
            // Keep only recent detections (last 200ms)
            detectionHistory = detectionHistory.filter(d => Date.now() - d.time < 200);
            
            // Apply confidence threshold
            const avgConfidence = detectionHistory.length > 0 
                ? detectionHistory.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.confidence, 0) / detectionHistory.length
                : 0.9;
            
            console.log(`📊 Detection confidence: ${(avgConfidence * 100).toFixed(1)}% (threshold: ${(window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
            
            // ===== DISABLED QUALITY SWITCHING (was causing instability) =====
            // Changing imageTargetSrc during tracking causes MindAR to reinitialize and lose lock.
            // The constant marker switching led to the find/lose/find/lose cycling.
            // Solution: Keep single stable marker, don't switch mid-tracking
            console.log('✅ Keeping single stable marker - quality switching DISABLED');
            
            // If below threshold, suppress the detection
            if (avgConfidence < window.detectionFilters.minConfidenceThreshold) {
                console.log('🚫 Detection rejected - below confidence threshold');
                return;
            }
            
            // Increment warmup counter
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount++;
            if (window.detectionFilters.frameCount < window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames) {
                console.log(`⏳ Warmup: frame ${window.detectionFilters.frameCount}/${window.detectionFilters.warmupFrames}`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Cancel any pending lost timeout since we found it again
            if (targetLostTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(targetLostTimeout);
                targetLostTimeout = null;
                console.log('🔄 Cancelled pending targetLost - re-detected!');
            }
            
            // Reset miss count and frameCount since we found it successfully
            window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
            window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0; // Reset warmup counter for next cycle
            
            // Apply exponential smoothing to anchor position for ultra-smooth tracking
            if (event.detail?.anchor) {
                const anchor = event.detail.anchor;
                
                // Store position in history
                window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.push({
                    x: anchor.x || 0,
                    y: anchor.y || 0,
                    z: anchor.z || 0,
                    scale: anchor.scale || 1
                });
                
                // Keep only last N positions
                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > window.detectionFilters.maxHistorySize) {
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.shift();
                }
                
                // Calculate smoothed position (weighted average - more weight to recent frames)
                if (window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length > 0) {
                    let smoothX = 0, smoothY = 0, smoothZ = 0, smoothScale = 0;
                    let totalWeight = 0;
                    
                    window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.forEach((pos, i) => {
                        // More recent positions get higher weight
                        const weight = (i + 1) / window.detectionFilters.positionHistory.length;
                        smoothX += pos.x * weight;
                        smoothY += pos.y * weight;
                        smoothZ += pos.z * weight;
                        smoothScale += pos.scale * weight;
                        totalWeight += weight;
                    });
                    
                    // Apply smoothed values back to anchor
                    anchor.x = smoothX / totalWeight;
                    anchor.y = smoothY / totalWeight;
                    anchor.z = smoothZ / totalWeight;
                    anchor.scale = smoothScale / totalWeight;
                }
            }
            
            // Detection passed all filters!
            if (!isTargetVisible) {
                isTargetVisible = true;
                console.log('✅ Target found and passed all filters! Dispatching custom event...');
                
                // Dispatch our own event that handlers can listen to
                const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersPassed', {
                    detail: {
                        anchor: event.detail?.anchor,
                        confidence: avgConfidence
                    }
                });
                scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
            }
        });
        
        // Listen for MindAR's targetLost event
        let targetLostTimeout = null;
        let lastTargetFoundTime = 0;
        
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', (event) => {
            console.log('❌ TargetLost event received from MindAR');
            
            // Check if this lost came too quickly after a found
            // If so, ignore it (it's just noise/flickering)
            const timeSinceLast = Date.now() - lastTargetFoundTime;
            if (timeSinceLast < 200) {
                console.log(`⚡ Ignoring quick targetLost (${timeSinceLast}ms after found) - likely flickering`);
                return;
            }
            
            // Only process if we have a targetLost timeout pending
            // This debounces rapid lost/found events
            if (!targetLostTimeout) {
                window.detectionFilters.missCount++;
                console.log(`⏳ Miss count: ${window.detectionFilters.missCount}/${window.detectionFilters.missFrames}`);
                
                // Start timeout - if no targetFound within 1000ms, then it's really lost
                targetLostTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.detectionFilters.missCount >= window.detectionFilters.missFrames) {
                        console.log('❌ Target truly lost after miss tolerance');
                        isTargetVisible = false;
                        window.detectionFilters.frameCount = 0;
                        window.detectionFilters.missCount = 0;
                        
                        // Dispatch our own event
                        const customEvent = new CustomEvent('trackingFiltersLost');
                        scene.dispatchEvent(customEvent);
                    }
                    targetLostTimeout = null;
                }, 1000); // Wait 1000ms (doubled from 500ms) to see if targetFound comes back
            }
        });

// Minimal MindAR test - just AR, nothing else
const API_URL = window.location.origin + '/api';

// Simple initialization
async function initAR() {
    console.log('🎯 MINIMAL AR TEST - Starting');
    
    try {
        // Fetch posters
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
        const posters = await response.json();
        console.log('✅ Fetched posters:', posters.length);
        
        if (!posters.length) {
            console.error('❌ No posters found');
            return;
        }
        
        // Get first poster with marker
        const poster = posters.find(p => p.ar_marker);
        if (!poster) {
            console.error('❌ No poster with marker');
            return;
        }
        
        console.log('📋 Using poster:', poster.title);
        const markerPath = poster.ar_marker.endsWith('.mind') ? poster.ar_marker : poster.ar_marker + '.mind';
        console.log('🎯 Marker path:', markerPath);
        
        // Get scene and set MindAR with ONLY the essentials
        const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
        
        // Simple attribute string - no custom parameters
        const attr = `imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no`;
        console.log('⚙️ Setting MindAR attribute:', attr);
        
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', attr);
        
        // Simple event listeners
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
            console.log('✅ FOUND');
        });
        
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log('❌ LOST');
        });
        
        console.log('✅ AR initialized');
        
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('❌ Error:', err);
    }
}

// Wait for page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAR);

// Fallback if already loaded
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAR);
} else {
    setTimeout(initAR, 100);
}

```

// Minimal MindAR test - just AR, nothing else
const API_URL = window.location.origin + '/api';

// Request camera permission explicitly
async function requestCameraPermission() {
    console.log('📸 Requesting camera permission...');
    try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: { facingMode: 'environment' }
        });
        console.log('✅ Camera permission granted');
        // Stop the stream - we just needed permission
        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        return true;
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('❌ Camera permission denied:', err);
        return false;
    }
}

// Simple initialization
async function initAR() {
    console.log('🎯 MINIMAL AR TEST - Starting');
    
    try {
        // Request camera first
        const hasCameraPermission = await requestCameraPermission();
        if (!hasCameraPermission) {
            console.error('❌ No camera permission');
            return;
        }
        
        // Fetch posters
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
        const posters = await response.json();
        console.log('✅ Fetched posters:', posters.length);
        
        if (!posters.length) {
            console.error('❌ No posters found');
            return;
        }
        
        // Get first poster with marker
        const poster = posters.find(p => p.ar_marker);
        if (!poster) {
            console.error('❌ No poster with marker');
            return;
        }
        
        console.log('📋 Using poster:', poster.title);
        const markerPath = poster.ar_marker.endsWith('.mind') ? poster.ar_marker : poster.ar_marker + '.mind';
        console.log('🎯 Marker path:', markerPath);
        
        // Get scene
        const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
        
        // Simple attribute string - autoStart: false so we can start it manually after permissions
        const attr = `imageTargetSrc: ${markerPath}; autoStart: true; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no`;
        console.log('⚙️ Setting MindAR attribute:', attr);
        
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', attr);
        
        // Create a target entity if it doesn't exist
        let target = scene.querySelector('[mindar-image-target]');
        if (!target) {
            console.log('📍 Creating target entity');
            target = document.createElement('a-entity');
            target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', 'targetIndex: 0');
            target.setAttribute('id', 'ar-target-0');
            
            // Add a simple box for testing
            const box = document.createElement('a-box');
            box.setAttribute('position', '0 0 0');
            box.setAttribute('color', 'red');
            box.setAttribute('scale', '0.5 0.5 0.5');
            target.appendChild(box);
            
            scene.appendChild(target);
            console.log('✅ Target entity created');
        }
        
        // Simple event listeners
        scene.addEventListener('targetFound', () => {
            console.log('✅ FOUND');
        });
        
        scene.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log('❌ LOST');
        });
        
        // Listen for MindAR ready event
        scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
            console.log('🚀 MindAR ready, camera active');
        });
        
        console.log('✅ AR initialized');
        
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('❌ Error:', err);
    }
}
```

// Request camera permission explicitly
async function requestCameraPermission() {
    console.log('📸 Requesting camera permission...');
    try {
        // Force 1x zoom by requesting specific resolution
        // Don't request too high resolution - keep it at 720p
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: { 
                facingMode: 'environment',
                width: { ideal: 720, max: 720 },
                height: { ideal: 480, max: 480 }
            }
        });
        console.log('✅ Camera permission granted');
        
        // Log camera track settings to see what we actually got
        const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
        const settings = track.getSettings();
        console.log('📹 Camera settings:', {
            width: settings.width,
            height: settings.height,
            zoom: settings.zoom || 'not supported'
        });
        
        // Try to set zoom to 1x if supported
        if (track.getCapabilities && track.getCapabilities().zoom) {
            try {
                await track.applyConstraints({ zoom: 1 });
                console.log('✅ Zoom forced to 1x');
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('⚠️ Could not set zoom:', e.message);
            }
        }
        
        // Stop the stream - we just needed permission
        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        return true;
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('❌ Camera permission denied:', err);
        return false;
    }
}
```

**Dit bewijst definitief: De `.mind` marker file zelf kan niet betrouwbaar tracken.** 🎯

MindAR vindt de marker (90% confidence!), maar verliest het onmiddellijk daarna. Dit gebeurt ook met de **NIEUWE markers die je hebt geupload** - dus het probleem zit niet in **die ene oude marker**, maar in hoe je markers worden **getraind**.

## Het echte probleem:

De `.mind` bestanden zijn waarschijnlijk getraind met **slechte trainingsafbeeldingen**:
- Afbeeldingen met te weinig unieke features
- Afbeeldingen in verschillende verlichting/hoeken dan de echte posters
- Afbeeldingen van te laag contrast
- De poster zelf is misschien veranderd sinds de training

## Oplossing:

Je moet je posters **opnieuw trainen** met de MindAR Marker Creator tool. Zorg dat je:

1. **De ECHTE poster fotografeert** (dezelfde die in het veld staat)
2. **Vanuit meerdere hoeken** (minstens 20-30 afbeeldingen)
3. **Onder verschillende verlichting** (daglicht, kunstlicht, etc)
4. **Met goede contrast** (geen blur, geen reflecties)

Good news! The site is working correctly. The errors you're seeing are **expected** when there are no posters uploaded:

✅ **What's working:**
- Device detection (iPhone detected, AR supported, WebGL available)
- Camera permission request (successful)
- Camera settings (1080x1920 resolution, 1x zoom, correct settings)
- localStorage syncing from admin panel
- A-Frame/MindAR initialization
- Gallery ready

❌ **Expected errors (not problems):**
1. **`Failed to load resource: 404`** - This is normal because you haven't uploaded any posters yet, so the `.mind` file doesn't exist
2. **`RangeError: Extra 1250 bytes found`** - This happens because MindAR tries to parse the 404 HTML response as a `.mind` file instead of actual data

**Summary:** Everything is working perfectly! Once you **upload a poster with a valid `.mind` file** via the admin panel, the AR should work.

**Next steps:**
1. Create/train a good `.mind` marker file for a poster
2. Upload it via admin panel (`www.interventie.org/admin/`)
3. Test the AR on `https://interventie.org`

Want me to help you with **marker training** to fix the jittering issue we identified earlier?

```
    // Save to database
    try {
        $stmt = $db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO posters (id, title, description, jpeg_filename, pdf_medium_filename, pdf_large_filename, thumbnail, latitude, longitude, location_description, artikel_link, photographer_credit, ar_marker, layers_data)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        
        $result = $stmt->execute([
            $id,
            $title,
            $description,
            $jpegFilename,
            $pdfMediumFilename,
            $pdfLargeFilename,
            '/uploads/thumbnails/' . $thumbnailFilename,
            $latitude,
            $longitude,
            $locationDescription,
            $artikelLink,
            $photographerCredit,
            $markerPath, // Save the marker path (without extension)
            json_encode($layersData)
        ]);
        
        if (!$result) {
            throw new Exception('Database insert failed');
        }
        
        // Log successful upload
        $locationInfo = '';
        if ($latitude !== null && $longitude !== null) {
            $locationInfo = " at coordinates ($latitude, $longitude)";
            if ($locationDescription) {
                $locationInfo .= " ($locationDescription)";
            }
        }
        $sourceInfo = '';
        if ($artikelLink) {
            $sourceInfo .= " | Article: $artikelLink";
        }
        if ($photographerCredit) {
            $sourceInfo .= " | Photo credit: $photographerCredit";
        }
        logAdminActivity('UPLOAD_SUCCESS', "$title$locationInfo$sourceInfo");
        
        // Get the poster
        $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT * FROM posters WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $poster = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        jsonResponse(['success' => true, 'poster' => $poster]);
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        logAdminActivity('UPLOAD_FAILED', 'Database error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        jsonResponse(['message' => 'Database fout: ' . $e->getMessage()], 500);
    }
```

Laat me kijken naar waar we `autoStart: true` stellen: 

Ik zie het probleem! We zetten `autoStart: true` op line 289, maar dit gebeurt in de `setMindARScene()` functie. Het probleem is dat deze functie te laat wordt aangeroepen - NADAT MindAR al is geinitialiseerd met `autoStart: false` in het HTML attribuut.

MindAR initialiseert zichzelf als het attribute wordt gesteld in HTML, en later veranderen via `setAttribute` werkt niet meer voor `autoStart`.

De oplossing is om `autoStart: true` direct in het HTML attribute te zetten:
</details></think>

```apache
AddType application/octet-stream .mind
<FilesMatch "\.mind$">
    Header set Content-Type "application/octet-stream"
    Header set Content-Disposition "inline"
</FilesMatch>
```

Dit forceert de server om `.mind` files als binary te serveren, niet als text.

Ah ja, browser cache! Probeer een **hard refresh** op je iPhone:

1. Sluit Safari volledig (swipe omhoog)
2. Open Safari opnieuw
3. Ga naar interventie.org
4. **Hard refresh**: Safari Safari menu (delen icoon) → "Settings" → "Clear History and Website Data"
5. OF: Hou **Reload knop ingedrukt** → "Hard Refresh"

Of sneller - voeg `?v=1` toe aan je URL:
```
https://interventie.org/?v=1
```

Dit forceert browser om alles opnieuw te laden (bypass cache).

Test dan opnieuw en stuur de console logs!

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR)
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene...');
    console.log('📱 MOBILE AR DEBUG - Start initialization');
    
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    
    // Load tracking settings from localStorage (set by admin panel)
    console.log('🔍 Checking localStorage for AR settings...');
    console.log('   ar_filterMinCF:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF'));
    console.log('   ar_filterBeta:', localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta'));
    console.log('   ar_warmupTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance'));
    console.log('   ar_missTolerance:', localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance'));
    
    // IMPORTANT: localStorage is domain-specific!
    // Admin might be on www.domain.com but AR view on domain.com
    // Try to fetch settings from API as fallback
    console.log('📍 Current domain:', window.location.hostname);
    console.log('📍 Admin domain: www.interventie.org');
    
    let filterMinCF = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterMinCF') || '0.003');
    let filterBeta = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('ar_filterBeta') || '0.025');
    let warmupTolerance = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_warmupTolerance') || '5');
    let missTolerance = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ar_missTolerance') || '5');
    
    // Try to fetch settings from API - this ensures cross-domain settings work
    // The API will return the latest settings saved from admin panel
    console.log('📥 Attempting to fetch latest AR settings from API...');
    
    // Use async IIFE to wait for API response before setting MindAR attributes
    (async () => {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/settings/ar-tracking`);
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data && (data.filterMinCF !== undefined || data.filterBeta !== undefined)) {
                // Use API values if they exist - the API always returns what's in ar-settings.json
                // (which was explicitly set by the admin)
                const apiMinCF = parseFloat(data.filterMinCF);
                const apiBeta = parseFloat(data.filterBeta);
                const apiWarmup = parseInt(data.warmupTolerance || '5');
                const apiMiss = parseInt(data.missTolerance || '5');
                
                // Always use API values since they represent what admin saved
                console.log('✅ Using settings from API (admin panel values):', data);
                filterMinCF = apiMinCF;
                filterBeta = apiBeta;
                warmupTolerance = apiWarmup;
                missTolerance = apiMiss;
                
                // Store in localStorage for this domain too
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterMinCF', filterMinCF.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_filterBeta', filterBeta.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_warmupTolerance', warmupTolerance.toString());
                localStorage.setItem('ar_missTolerance', missTolerance.toString());
                
                console.log('💾 Synced API settings to localStorage');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('⚠️ Could not fetch settings from API:', err);
            console.log('ℹ️ Using localStorage values or defaults');
        }
        
        // NOW set the MindAR parameters with the correct values (after API fetch completes)
        setMindARScene(scene, filterMinCF, filterBeta, warmupTolerance, missTolerance);
    })();
}

// Store current settings in sessionStorage
const trackingSettings = {
    filterMinCF: parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem('filterMinCF') || '0.75'),
    filterBeta: parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem('filterBeta') || '10'),
    warmupTolerance: parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('warmupTolerance') || '5'),
    missTolerance: parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('missTolerance') || '5')
};

function setupTrackingSettingsPanel() {
    const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('settings-btn');
    const panel = document.getElementById('tracking-settings-panel');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-settings-btn');
    const applyBtn = document.getElementById('apply-settings-btn');
    
    if (!settingsBtn || !panel) return;
    
    // Show/hide panel
    settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        panel.style.display = panel.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
    
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        panel.style.display = 'none';
    });
    
    // Slider value display updates
    const sliders = {
        'filterMinCF-slider': 'filterMinCF-value',
        'filterBeta-slider': 'filterBeta-value',
        'warmupTolerance-slider': 'warmupTolerance-value',
        'missTolerance-slider': 'missTolerance-value'
    };
    
    Object.entries(sliders).forEach(([sliderId, valueId]) => {
        const slider = document.getElementById(sliderId);
        const valueSpan = document.getElementById(valueId);
        if (slider && valueSpan) {
            slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                valueSpan.textContent = e.target.value;
                // Update trackingSettings object
                const key = sliderId.replace('-slider', '');
                trackingSettings[key] = isNaN(parseFloat(e.target.value)) ? parseInt(e.target.value) : parseFloat(e.target.value);
            });
        }
    });
    
    // Apply button
    applyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Save to sessionStorage
        sessionStorage.setItem('filterMinCF', trackingSettings.filterMinCF);
        sessionStorage.setItem('filterBeta', trackingSettings.filterBeta);
        sessionStorage.setItem('warmupTolerance', trackingSettings.warmupTolerance);
        sessionStorage.setItem('missTolerance', trackingSettings.missTolerance);
        
        console.log('📊 Applied tracking settings:', trackingSettings);
        
        // Restart AR with new settings
        location.reload();
    });
    
    // Preset buttons
    const presets = {
        'preset-responsive': {
            filterMinCF: 0.3,
            filterBeta: 2,
            warmupTolerance: 2,
            missTolerance: 2
        },
        'preset-balanced': {
            filterMinCF: 0.75,
            filterBeta: 10,
            warmupTolerance: 5,
            missTolerance: 5
        },
        'preset-strict': {
            filterMinCF: 0.95,
            filterBeta: 15,
            warmupTolerance: 8,
            missTolerance: 8
        }
    };
    
    Object.entries(presets).forEach(([btnId, preset]) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
        if (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Update sliders
                document.getElementById('filterMinCF-slider').value = preset.filterMinCF;
                document.getElementById('filterMinCF-value').textContent = preset.filterMinCF;
                
                document.getElementById('filterBeta-slider').value = preset.filterBeta;
                document.getElementById('filterBeta-value').textContent = preset.filterBeta;
                
                document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-slider').value = preset.warmupTolerance;
                document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-value').textContent = preset.warmupTolerance;
                
                document.getElementById('missTolerance-slider').value = preset.missTolerance;
                document.getElementById('missTolerance-value').textContent = preset.missTolerance;
                
                console.log('🎯 Applied preset:', btnId, preset);
            });
        }
    });
}

// Initialize settings panel on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    setupTrackingSettingsPanel();
});

// ==================== AR TRACKING SETTINGS ====================

// Store current settings in sessionStorage
const trackingSettings = {
    filterMinCF: parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem('filterMinCF') || '0.75'),
    filterBeta: parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem('filterBeta') || '10'),
    warmupTolerance: parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('warmupTolerance') || '5'),
    missTolerance: parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem('missTolerance') || '5')
};

function setupTrackingSettingsPanel() {
    const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('settings-btn');
    const panel = document.getElementById('tracking-settings-panel');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-settings-btn');
    const applyBtn = document.getElementById('apply-settings-btn');
    
    if (!settingsBtn || !panel) return;
    
    // Show/hide panel
    settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        panel.style.display = panel.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
    
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        panel.style.display = 'none';
    });
    
    // Slider value display updates
    const sliders = {
        'filterMinCF-slider': 'filterMinCF-value',
        'filterBeta-slider': 'filterBeta-value',
        'warmupTolerance-slider': 'warmupTolerance-value',
        'missTolerance-slider': 'missTolerance-value'
    };
    
    Object.entries(sliders).forEach(([sliderId, valueId]) => {
        const slider = document.getElementById(sliderId);
        const valueSpan = document.getElementById(valueId);
        if (slider && valueSpan) {
            slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                valueSpan.textContent = e.target.value;
                // Update trackingSettings object
                const key = sliderId.replace('-slider', '');
                trackingSettings[key] = isNaN(parseFloat(e.target.value)) ? parseInt(e.target.value) : parseFloat(e.target.value);
            });
        }
    });
    
    // Apply button
    applyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Save to sessionStorage
        sessionStorage.setItem('filterMinCF', trackingSettings.filterMinCF);
        sessionStorage.setItem('filterBeta', trackingSettings.filterBeta);
        sessionStorage.setItem('warmupTolerance', trackingSettings.warmupTolerance);
        sessionStorage.setItem('missTolerance', trackingSettings.missTolerance);
        
        console.log('📊 Applied tracking settings:', trackingSettings);
        
        // Restart AR with new settings
        location.reload();
    });
    
    // Preset buttons
    const presets = {
        'preset-responsive': {
            filterMinCF: 0.3,
            filterBeta: 2,
            warmupTolerance: 2,
            missTolerance: 2
        },
        'preset-balanced': {
            filterMinCF: 0.75,
            filterBeta: 10,
            warmupTolerance: 5,
            missTolerance: 5
        },
        'preset-strict': {
            filterMinCF: 0.95,
            filterBeta: 15,
            warmupTolerance: 8,
            missTolerance: 8
        }
    };
    
    Object.entries(presets).forEach(([btnId, preset]) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
        if (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                Object.assign(trackingSettings, preset);
                // Update all sliders and displays
                document.getElementById('filterMinCF-slider').value = preset.filterMinCF;
                document.getElementById('filterMinCF-value').textContent = preset.filterMinCF;
                document.getElementById('filterBeta-slider').value = preset.filterBeta;
                document.getElementById('filterBeta-value').textContent = preset.filterBeta;
                document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-slider').value = preset.warmupTolerance;
                document.getElementById('warmupTolerance-value').textContent = preset.warmupTolerance;
                document.getElementById('missTolerance-slider').value = preset.missTolerance;
                document.getElementById('missTolerance-value').textContent = preset.missTolerance;
                
                console.log('🎯 Applied preset:', btnId, preset);
            });
        }
    });
}

// Initialize settings panel on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    setupTrackingSettingsPanel();
});
